Author: HGD-Angelyx
Name: Face Camera Toggle
Punchline: Toggleable always face camera for macros.
Description: Makes your character look at the camera (like HaselTweaks' Always Face Camera) and can be toggled on and off with a macro via /afc.
Changelog: Added config UI window with enable/eye-only toggles. Eye-only mode now correctly uses only eye tracking without head rotation.
